data.one_liner: Fully customizable OTP entry text field widget supporting any pin length.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable OTP text field widget for Flutter that splits pin entry across multiple boxes or dashes. It supports custom styling per field, obscure text, clearing text, auto-focus, paste functionality, and callbacks for input changes and submission.
use_when: You need a dedicated OTP or verification code entry screen element
You want customized text fields with specific styles for pin inputs
avoid_when: You need a full form validation and building framework rather than just an OTP entry component
strengths: Pure Dart with no extra dependencies
Supports custom input decorations and text styles for individual fields
Built-in support for pasting OTP codes and clearing text
weaknesses: Limited to OTP and pin entry use cases
No built-in animation system mentioned beyond basic states
